resources.string: Standard backup omits webhook details and cannot fully restore rules. Phone, SMS, Wi-Fi, and other rule data remain. Share only with people you trust.
FlowPilot exports omit webhook URLs, headers, and bodies. Re-enter missing fields after import. Imported rules remain disabled until you enable them.

Replace all permanently deletes your existing rules and their saved webhook settings. Missing URLs, headers, credentials, and bodies cannot be recovered from a sanitized export. Re-enter them manually. Merge instead to keep existing rules.
I understand that existing rules and saved webhook settings will be deleted.
